title: 第729章 万年了他们也该安息了第728章 这处秘境到底有多大
slug: 人在合欢宗开局成为圣女道侣
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：人在合欢宗，开局成为圣女道侣！第一卷：默认第729章万年了……他们也该安息了。（..la）听到狄夜瑶这直白的话，
长鱼晚晴惊得美目瞪圆，声音里满是不可置信：
“夜瑶仙子，你没与我说笑吧？
你也算是这北域十大美人之一，多少天骄俊杰排着队求娶你，你……你竟还要与我争抢道侣？”
狄夜瑶却摇了摇头，语气平静：“不是抢。”
她顿了顿，
目光落在长鱼晚晴那张微红的脸上，
带着一种让人无法生气的坦诚，
“晚晴，你有没有想过……我们或许可以共享？”
闻言，长鱼晚晴当场愣在原地，
脑袋里嗡的一声，像是被一道无形的雷霆劈中。
她张了张嘴，
指着狄夜瑶的手都在微微发抖：
“你你你……还说你不是抢？！连如此羞人的话你都说得出口！”
长鱼晚晴嘴上慌乱，
心里却有一丝她自己都不敢承认的念头闪过。
不是不愿，是不敢想。
那种念头一旦冒出来，就再也收不回去了。
狄夜瑶看着她又急又羞的模样，忽然扑哧一声笑了出来。
她非但没有后退，

反而上前一步，轻轻拉住了她那只发抖的手：
“晚晴，我真没有要抢的意思。我只是……想将这些话说出来而已。”
狄夜瑶发现，
长鱼晚晴虽然看着清冷高傲，骨子里竟如此保守。
她方才那番话，一半真，一半是故意逗她的。
可看到她这般反应，
狄夜瑶心中反倒生出一丝真切的好感。
这个女人，倒是个值得相交之人。
笑过之后，
狄夜瑶美目一凝，快速取出灵犀令，
她将神识探入其中，仔细感应了片刻，面色微微一怔：
“不好！我还是感应不到叶大哥的位置，但有兄长和雷猛师兄的踪迹了，距离我们不算太远，我们先过去与他们汇合。”
她说着，
又将令牌递向长鱼晚晴，“你且再试试。”
长鱼晚晴接过灵犀令，探入神识，片刻后也摇了摇头：
“我也感应不到叶尘。”
她微微一顿，又补了一句，
“还有，我也感应不到梦然妹妹的位置……”
提到长鱼梦然时，她目光微微沉了一瞬。
虽然长鱼梦然与她并不亲近，可终究是血脉相连的姐妹，

在这片凶险莫测的秘境之中下落不明，她心中终究放心不下。
狄夜瑶看着她眼底那抹一闪而过的担忧，心神微动。
只是将令牌收起，
抬手指向远方一处地势略高的土坡：
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Become a saintly Taoist monk in the Hehuan Sect! Volume 1: Default Chapter 729 It’s been ten thousand years... It’s time for them to rest in peace. (..la) After hearing Di Yesayao’s straightforward words,
Changyu Wanqing was so shocked that her eyes widened with disbelief in her voice:
"Fairy Ye Yao, you are not joking with me, are you?
You are also considered one of the top ten beauties in the Northern Territory. How many talented people are queuing up to ask for your hand in marriage? You...you actually want to compete with me for a Taoist companion? "
Di Yeyao shook his head and said calmly: "It's not a robbery."
She paused,
His eyes fell on Changyu Wanqing's reddish face,
With a frankness that makes one unable to take offense,
"Wanqing, have you ever thought... maybe we can share?"
Hearing this, Changyu Wanqing froze on the spot.
There was a buzzing sound in his head, as if he was struck by an invisible thunder.
She opened her mouth,
The hand pointing at Di Yesao was trembling slightly:
"You, you, you...you said you weren't robbing?! You can even say such shameful words!"
Changyu Wanqing's mouth was flustered,
But there was a thought flashing through her heart that she didn't even dare to admit.
It’s not that I don’t want to, it’s that I don’t dare to think about it.
Once that thought comes up, you can never take it back.
Di Yeyao looked at her anxious and shy look, and suddenly burst into laughter.
Not only did she not retreat,
Instead, he took a step forward and gently held her trembling hand:
"Wan Qing, I really didn't mean to rob you. I just...wanted to say these words."
Di Yeyao discovered,
Although Changyu Wanqing looks cold and arrogant, she is actually so conservative in her heart.
What she just said was half true and half meant to tease her.
But seeing her react like this,
Di Yeyao felt a real good impression in her heart.
This woman is actually a person worth getting to know.
After laughing,
Di Yeyao's beautiful eyes narrowed, and she quickly took out the Lingxi Token.
She probed her consciousness into it and sensed it carefully for a moment, then her face was slightly startled:
"No! I still can't sense Brother Ye's location, but there are traces of my elder brother and Senior Brother Lei Meng. They are not too far away from us. Let's go and join them first."
She said,
Then he handed the token to Changyu Wanqing, "Try again."
Changyu Wanqing took the Lingxi Order, probed into her spiritual consciousness, and shook her head after a moment:
"I can't sense Ye Chen either."
She paused slightly and added,
"Also, I can't sense the location of sister Mengran..."
When she mentioned Changyu Mengran, her eyes darkened slightly for a moment.
Although Changyu Mengran is not close to her, they are sisters connected by blood after all.
Her whereabouts were unknown in this dangerous and unpredictable secret land, and she couldn't rest assured after all.
Di Yeyao's mind moved slightly as she saw the flash of worry in her eyes.
Just put the token away,
He raised his hand and pointed to a slightly higher slope in the distance:
